cards.title: Battery protection and cut-offs
cards.intro: Only the cut-offs that apply to your control types are shown. Use the wizard for a checked change.

cards.title: Charge from grid
cards.intro: Shown while AC charging is on. Fields follow the charge type: SOC, voltage or time.

cards.text: AC charging is on but **AC Charge Type** is *Disable*, so nothing will charge. Pick a type in *Operating mode*.

cards.title: AC charging window
cards.hint: Inside a window the battery does not discharge: the house runs on the grid. Start = end means unused.

cards.title: Charge first (PV)
cards.intro: Shown while Charge first is on.

cards.title: Charge first window
cards.hint: Inside a window PV charges the battery before the house. Start = end means unused.

cards.title: Forced discharge
cards.intro: Shown while Forced discharge is on.

cards.title: Forced discharge window
cards.hint: Inside a window the battery is discharged at the forced-discharge power. Start = end means unused.

cards.title: AC priority schedule
cards.intro: During these windows the grid carries the house and PV charges the battery; outside them PV and battery carry it. All 00:00 means unused.

cards.title: AC priority schedule (T1-T3)
cards.hint: Inside a window the grid carries the house and PV charges the battery. Start = end means unused.

cards.title: Grid, export and peak shaving
cards.intro: Export needs hybrid mode (PV & AC load jointly). The export limit shows when export is on, CT offset when a CT is fitted, peak shaving fields when it is on.

confirmation.text: Change CT connection? Enable it only if an external CT is actually wired, or power control will be wrong.
